import java.util.*;

public class Solver {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int MAXE = 400005;
    static final int SRC = 501;
    static final int SNK = 502;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;

    char[][] a = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    char[][] b = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    int[][] disZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    int[][][][] disPair = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
    ArrayDeque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
    int[] head = new int[505];
    int[] dep = new int[505];
    int[] vis = new int[505];
    int[] pre = new int[505];
    int edgeCnt = 0;
    int ans = 0;
    int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    class Edge {
        int u, v, fl, c, n;
        Edge(int u, int v, int fl, int c, int n) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.fl = fl;
            this.c = c;
            this.n = n;
        }
    }

    Edge[] e = new Edge[MAXE + 1];

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        e[++edgeCnt] = new Edge(u, v, 0, cap, head[u]);
        head[u] = edgeCnt;
        e[++edgeCnt] = new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = edgeCnt;
    }

    boolean bfsLevel() {
        ArrayDeque<Integer> qu = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= SNK; i++) {
            vis[i] = 0;
            dep[i] = 0;
        }
        qu.addLast(SRC);
        vis[SRC] = 1;
        dep[SRC] = 1;
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qu.removeFirst();
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = e[i].n) {
                int y = e[i].v;
                if (vis[y] == 0 && e[i].fl < e[i].c) {
                pre[y] = i;
                vis[y] = 1;
                dep[y] = dep[x] + 1;
                qu.addLast(y);
                if (y == SNK) return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

int dfs(int x, int now) {
    if (x == SNK || now == 0) return now;
    int rem = now;
    for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = e[i].n) {
        int y = e[i].v;
        if (e[i].c > e[i].fl && dep[y] == dep[x] + 1) {
            int delta = dfs(y, Math.min(rem, e[i].c - e[i].fl));
            if (delta == 0) dep[y] = 0;
            e[i].fl += delta;
            int rev = (i % 2 == 1) ? i + 1 : i - 1;
            e[rev].fl -= delta;
            rem -= delta;
            if (rem == 0) break;
        }
    }
    return now - rem;
}

int run() {
    Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
    int n = sc.nextInt();
    int limit = sc.nextInt();
    sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

    // Initialize disZ with large value
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            disZ[i][j] = 10000;
        }
    }

    // Read matrix a and add edges from source
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        String line = sc.nextLine();
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            a[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                q.addLast(new int[]{i, j});
                disZ[i][j] = 0;
            }
            if (a[i][j] >= '0' && a[i][j] <= '9') {
                addEdge(SRC, (i - 1) * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }
    }

    // BFS for disZ
    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
        int[] cur = q.removeFirst();
        int x = cur[0];
        int y = cur[1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int nx = x + dx[i];
            int ny = y + dy[i];
            if (nx >= 1 && ny >= 1 && nx <= n && ny <= n && a[nx][ny] >= '0' && a[nx][ny] <= '9' && disZ[nx][ny] > disZ[x][y] + 1) {
                disZ[nx][ny] = disZ[x][y] + 1;
                q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    // BFS for disPair and add edges
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (a[i][j] > '9') continue;
            // Initialize disPair for this (i,j)
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                    disPair[i][j][k][l] = 10000;
                }
            }
            q.addLast(new int[]{i, j});
            disPair[i][j][i][j] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int[] cur = q.removeFirst();
                int x = cur[0];
                int y = cur[1];
                for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                    int nx = x + dx[f];
                    int ny = y + dy[f];
                    if (nx >= 1 && ny >= 1 && nx <= n && ny <= n && a[nx][ny] >= '0' && a[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                        disPair[i][j][nx][ny] > disPair[i][j][x][y] + 1 &&
                        disPair[i][j][x][y] < disZ[x][y]) {
                        disPair[i][j][nx][ny] = disPair[i][j][x][y] + 1;
                        q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                    int minDis = Math.min(disZ[k][l], limit);
                    if (disPair[i][j][k][l] <= minDis) {
                        addEdge((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    }

    // Read matrix b and add edges to sink
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        String line = sc.nextLine();
        for (int j = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            if (b[i][j] >= '0' && b[i][j] <= '9') {
            addEdge((i - 1) * n + j + 100, SNK, b[i][j] - '0');
        }
    }
}

    // Dinic max flow
    while (bfsLevel()) {
        ans += dfs(SRC, INF);
    }

    System.out.println(ans);
    return 0;
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    Solver solver = new Solver();
    solver.run();
}
}
